objects.text: WATER TREATMENT · DOSING AND PRESSURE CONTROL
A1 receives two distinct pressure voltages. PS1 feeds the control circuits through XT1.
FILTER INLET AND OUTLET PRESSURES · B1 AND B2
Both OUT2 links assume voltage mode. Sensor suitability, range, scaling and filter differential limits remain unassigned.
XT2 exposes a normally open enable contact. The external dosing controller, dose logic and permissives remain unassigned.
W-01 connects the external ready contact to DI a.0. Any program use of the ready input remains unassigned.
W-02 connects the external running contact to DI a.1. The input reports the external controller contact, independently of the enable command.
W-03 connects the external contact that closes on fault to DI a.2. Contact selection and fault handling remain unassigned.
XT6 marks the incoming L, N and PE boundary. PS1 feeds XT1. Incoming protection and conductor sizing remain unassigned.
CABINET AND DOSING ENCLOSURE PROTECTIVE EARTH · XT7
XT7 carries PE to the cabinet and dosing equipment enclosure terminal boundaries. Physical bonding and conductor sizing remain unassigned.
